name: contract-history-blob-cache
goal: History reconstruction shares bounded immutable blob reads across source revisions with verified Git object formats

evidence: The ten-revision all-source history sample takes68.46 seconds and about2.98GB peak RSS. CommitTreeAdapter caches text only per instance, re-reading unchanged source blobs in later trees. Reuse must be bounded and keyed only after establishing Git object format.

The adapter has no own method/state suite; the platform catalog integration only proves selected-revision values. Initial entity-contract migration adds the complete three-public-method by empty/populated matrix, six stable cases. Strengthen read/populated for repeated blob reads and original-tree isolation; open/populated rejects unknown formats.
